applicability: Next/previous block traversal in the intent-review reading column for the shown comparison.
conditions: The stop order is the shown subjects' drawn changed blocks in display order, followed by the read code-without-invariant hunks.
A subject listed under multiple families draws its blocks only at its first occurrence; another occurrence is a selection place, not duplicate blocks.
A card that draws multiple entries keeps every entry's distinct identity as an alias for its one traversal stop; summary location counts continue to count entries.
With nothing selected, either command selects the first block. From a family, subject, folded group or unread lane file, movement is relative to that displayed place.
At an end, the selection stays and the polite end message names the absence of an earlier or later block.
exclusions: Treating every family occurrence or every alias of one shared region as a separate traversal stop.
Unchanged and not-comparable grouped locations as changed-block stops.
Tree-arrow focus navigation, text-input keystrokes and commands outside their admitted review zone.

evidence: ReviewSurface.navigation.test.tsx mounted j/k/Next/Previous shared occurrence case; l86-repair-W2/tree.md
